# Export completed tasks

## Context
Original request: Add --include-completed to the task export CLI so completed tasks can be included. Keep the current default and JSON format.

## Proposal
AC1. Without the flag the CLI exports only incomplete records, in input order.
AC2. With --include-completed the CLI exports every input record, in input order.
Add a CLI boolean option and an optional include_completed argument to exporter.export. Preserve the record shape. Verify both CLI invocations and the focused export checks.

import argparse
import json
from exporter import export

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("input")
parser.add_argument("--include-completed", action="store_true")

import json
import subprocess
import sys
import unittest
from exporter import export

class ExportTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_default(self):
        result = subprocess.check_output([sys.executable, "cli.py", "records.json"], text=True)
        self.assertEqual([r["id"] for r in json.loads(result)], [1])

    def test_completed(self):
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(export([{"id": 2, "completed": True}], include_completed=True)), [{"id": 2, "completed": True}])
